review: S20 independent TDD and reliability review

reviewed.semanticRed: Evidence records assertion-level RED for live owner collision, recycled PID publication, START-ready barrier, full ingress enumeration, owner/publication rename races, and real legacy migration before ready. Earlier failing snapshots were not rerun against this frozen revision.
reviewed.ownerExclusivity: Every new owner and publication lock acquisition passes through an atomic sidecar gate. A competing live owner is rejected before worker construction or SQLite open; dead and reused-PID records are recoverable when process identity proves death. The sidecar prevents another contender replacing a dead lock between inspection and rename.
reviewed.startupRecovery: Worker START-ready precedes legacy migration and interrupted-job reconciliation. Migration reads keyset pages of at most 32. The S20 test creates 3,101 real legacy jobs and audits observed page sizes and count, verifies query/cancel replies before migration completion, gates a new save ACK, and replays its durable intent after migration.
reviewed.boundedReplay: Private intent discovery uses directory iteration; the S20 fixture prohibits full ingress readdirSync and verifies an actual saved intent reaches the ledger.
reviewed.regressions: S09 and S17 remain unchanged. S10, S11, and S19 assertions were adapted to asynchronous readiness without dropping durable identity, latest-wins, or recovery checks. Allowing failed or cancelled for a superseded old claim matches its terminal-state contract.

independentCommands.result: PASS, 21 assertions; 3,101 modern jobs; ready 438 ms

openGates.finding: Configured product startup still invokes SearchEngine.initialize, which schedules main-thread source-ledger reconciliation, materializes recoverable jobs, and writes ledger state outside the owner lock. Product-wide DB-free bounded startup remains unverified.
S20 does not yet assert a real SQLite checksum and search result for the previous committed keyword generation through rebuild cancel and failure.
A crash while the short atomic sidecar gate is held intentionally fails closed; explicit operator recovery and cold packaged-app behavior remain outside this partial Node fixture.

scope: This verdict permits the isolated worker/lock/test changes to be committed as partial progress. It does not mark any requirement verified or permit issue #43 to close.
